// diagnostic

E1298

tool provider `{source}` isn't available yet

What

tool provider `{source}` isn't available yet

Why

JPK-TOOL-PROVIDER: `jetpack tool` accepts external providers (`npm`, `pypi`, `cargo`, …) so the surface is discoverable, but that provider has no hangar realization path yet — Jet never silently skips. Built-ins that work today include `nixpkgs` and `github`; local paths are bare.

Fix

use a built-in ref (`name@nixpkgs`, `owner/repo@github`) or a bare local path, or wait for the `{source}` provider to land.
